title: EquiMed-DSS: a Python library for clinical-AI fairness assessment
description: EquiMed-DSS is a Python library for clinical artificial-intelligence fairness assessment. It implements 37 metrics: 26 in five core domains, 2 in a geographic equity module and 9 in an advanced appendix. Each result reports a point estimate with a 95% confidence interval when the inputs can be resampled, and states when an interval is unavailable.
